Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Events are reported to the VEKN via the Archon file.

Check this: vekn.net/forum/10-news-and-announcements/48223-archon-upload-functionality-released

Unless an Archon was submitted, nothing will magically happen.
If an Archon was submitted, your NC (Ben) is the person to ping in order to get your event approved. (However, I know for myself that I only check the Approve Event page once a week, tops, and only when I know an event occurred in my country)
